assessments.reasoning: LaTeX3 Project 1.3c acquisition 6f8889fd45fa4ddba794d8cb883bfa4b. Range [5345,18225), SHA-256 d4fc9f7eeb914307da183028e1d8d5cfb3ea1068b71fb6c180bd894f98609bf3, includes both clause 6 and the later non-replacement passage. Reading both resolves the apparent breadth of the clause 6 lead-in and supports the expressly conditional proposition.

limitations: A work-specific conclusion requires evidence of intended replacement use, derivation, maintainer status, component notices and the actual distribution. This claim establishes one conditional requirement.
reasoning: Where clause 6(d) applies to a non-Current Maintainer's distribution, at least one item must accompany the Derived Work: a complete, unmodified copy of the Work or information sufficient to obtain one. If a modified component is offered for copying at a designated place, equivalent access to the Work from the same or a similar place satisfies the first option. Recipients need not copy both.
